About this item

  • 4 MACHINES IN 1: Brew without limits with no guesswork espresso, well-balanced drip coffee, rapid cold brew, and an independent hot water system. 5 Espresso Styles — single, double shot or quad shot, ristretto & lungo. 3 Drip Coffee Styles—classic, rich or over ice, 2 Cold Brew styles — cold pressed espresso or cold brew coffee, and Independent Hot Water System – americanos, tea, and hot chocolate (drip coffee and cold brew available in 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 18 oz. sizes).
  • BARISTA ASSIST TECHNOLOGY: Unlock the ultimate guided experience with customized grind-size recommendations, weight-based dosing, and active brew adjustments for temperature & pressure for balanced flavor. Cafe-quality brews, no guesswork required.
  • INTEGRATED TAMPER: Tamp your grounds easily and mess free with the push of a lever, no overflowing grounds.
  • DUAL FROTH SYSTEM PRO: Unlock more froth options with the easy-to-clean, insulated steam wand and XL Milk Jug. Elevate your at-home coffee routine and create froth for two drinks with 5 preset froth functions including steamed milk, thin froth, thick froth, extra-thick froth, and cold foam.
  • GRIND SIZE RECOMMENDATIONS: Barista Assist Technology monitors each brew and adapts the grind size recommendation based on the previous brew to eliminate trial and error, or dial in based on your personal preferences. Note that you can prevent sour or bitter brews by following the recommended grind size.
  • INTEGRATED GRINDER AND WEIGHT-BASED DOSING: The conical burr grinder has 25 grind settings to deliver a fresh grind for versatile drink options. Built-in scale unlocks weight-based dosing tailored for your chosen drink. Other machines simply grind for a set amount of time, and you need to manually weigh your grounds.
  • HANDS-FREE FROTHING: Whether using dairy or plant-based milk, creating hot or cold microfoam, the Dual Froth System Pro combines steaming and whisking at the same time to effortlessly create perfectly textured microfoam, no skills required.
  • FLAVORFUL COLD-PRESSED DRINKS: Espresso brewed at lower temperature and pressure, at a slower pace to extract a more flavorful, smooth brew. Perfect for creating a crowd-pleasing espresso martini.
  • BUILT-IN STORAGE: Keep brew baskets, brush, and cleaning disc in the built-in storage compartment.
  • WHAT’S INCLUDED: Portafilter, XL Milk Jug, Single Basket, Double Basket, Luxe Basket, Cleaning Brush, Cleaning Disc, Descaling Powder, Cleaning tablets, Hard Water Testing Kit, Instructions & Inspiration Guide.

Product Description

The ultimate guided experience that makes espresso uncomplicated. The Ninja Luxe™ Café Pro Series is an intelligent espresso & coffee system with unmatched 4-in-1 versatility (no guesswork espresso machine, well balanced drip coffee maker, rapid cold brew creator and independent hot water system), that helps you elevate your coffee routine and create café-quality drinks at home. Create perfect pucks at the pull of a lever with the integrated tamper. Barista Assist Technology™ guides you to the perfect cup from grind size recommendations to automated brew adjustments, while the Dual Froth System Pro effortlessly creates perfectly textured microfoam hands-free. Easy-to-clean, insulated steam wand and XL Milk Jug elevate your at-home coffee routine, and create froth for two drinks with 5 preset froth functions including steamed milk, thin froth, thick froth, extra-thick froth, and cold foam.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

We love this machine
I went to Walmart one day for a few items and passed this Ninja Pro Luxe espresso maker. I came home and told my husband about it and he said to order it. When it came and we opened it, I gotta say it was pretty intimidating. It scared me to death thinking we would never figure this out. We read all the instructions on it and started experimenting and to our surprise it was so easy. We are fans of what I call designer coffee. It makes the best Lattes. Even as good or better than what you buy at the coffee shops. We will no longer spend our money on coffee out. We have really enjoyed it. DO NOT BE INTIMIDATED BY THIS MACHINE. You will be amazed at how easy it is to use.

    Reviewed in the United States on November 8, 2025

    I love this machine! After two years of researching, even trying out different machines, this one is perfect! I got the upgraded ES701 series and am glad I did. I am a big coffee ninja fan and this one replaced my Ninja Coffee Bar that I have used for years, but the water tank leaks when removed and it is harder to find parts now for that model.

    This machine grinds your beans, tamps the coffee by a lever, allows you to make expresso, double expresso to multiple size coffees or cold brews from 6 oz up to 18 oz large cups (remove the bottom plate for jumbo cups), froths and self rinses without disassembling. It is easy and amazing. In the video I walked my husband through the steps prior to filming and show him making his first cup of coffee. He is NOT techy! You can grind your beans or use preground coffee. This morning I used mushroom coffee. Everyone can finally be a barista! The rubber mats in my photos are not included but you can find on Amazon. I love this has a removable water tank in case your overhead cabinets prevent you from getting a water pitcher under them to fill. Our coffee bar is not near sink and this was one of the problems we had with another unit we tried with a water tank that could not be removed. It also has a side storage door to store unused expresso equipment. This unit addressed all of our wishes!! Pricey yes, the most I have ever paid for a coffee maker, but worth it!

    I researched extensively before buying this espresso machine. I came across a number of reports of defective machines but decided to take a chance based on Ninja’s reputation. I’m so glad I did! The machine is extremely solid and well built. It can make everything from regular coffee to espresso to iced coffees. This is a very sophisticated machine and reading the manual is essential for a good result. The coffee produced smells and tastes amazing. The milk frother works better than any frother I’ve had before. The bean hopper holds a large amount of coffee beans which I appreciate. I find the speed of the machine to be good and comparable to other espresso machines I’ve had. I’ve seen reports of the coffee produced being too hot or too cold but mine has been perfect for me for each type of drink. Given the many different types of coffee beverages this machine makes with ease, I highly recommend it. In fact, I went to stay with relatives for a month over the holidays and I took the machine with me!

    A good foray into coffee
    Reviewed in the United States on July 4, 2026
    Color: Stainless Steel
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.

    I'm very happy with this machine and its ability to make different types of coffee. I don't intend to use it for drip at all, but I've been using it for espresso-type drinks with excellent results. The fact that it makes brewing easy, while still keeping you mostly in control, mostly means you're learning about WHY something is working or isn't working. This machine helps you tweak temperature, strength, and extraction separately. You get guidance, but it's up to you if you listen to it based on what you're trying to extract. Is it perfect? No. It's not meant to be, though. It's meant to be convenient for a beginner. That said, it's expensive, but you do get good functionality for that price.

    I wanted something that wouldn't take away my ability to tweak, in case I got more into espresso, but if I decided not to I could still get good coffee. This delivers.

  • ELL
    4 out of 5 stars
    Greatest coffee any way you like it!
    Reviewed in the United States on February 10, 2026
    Color: Stainless Steel
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    It is the best coffee machine I’ve ever had and I’ve had a rainbow of them however it could do better on the Crema of the espresso as it is not very cream thick, but everything else is great especially the frother, it takes away that has work to make great cappuccinos and incredible chilled coffee drinks! The materials of it look really good even though it’s not stainless steel the whole thing and it does have several parts that are made out of PVC. I think the cost is a little high, but I guess with everything that it comes with, including the semi automatic tamper is also a super convenient feature, you can see it’ll last you for years. The only downside to it is that the use of water is quite a lot so you have to be emptying the tray constantly after you make around to good drinks. I think ninja should look into integrating a rubber doing for discharging this water into your sink and that would solve the problem! The coffee quality depends on what coffee beans you use but as far as functionality with the beans, it’s great the brew speed, coffee, quality, and heat level of it are great as well. The capacity you get on each beverage is also great and especially by the fact that you can choose from Ristretto, espresso, Lungo and Americano among other to choose from. It also gives you automatically the number that you should match to the machines suggestion in order to have the perfect grind for your choice of drink. Last but not least it comes with Storage for your coffee, tools so they are entirely hidden from site inside the machine on the right side. The only downside this machine has is the fact that it accumulates a lot of water as the byproduct of making the different coffee choices. It should come with a drain tube to go directly into the sink or spout! The counter space it takes is a little bit chunky but against having an espresso machine and a drip coffee machine it’s a win-win! I think it’s a great upgrade from the last Ninja, but the pro series is incredible!

  • Orleon Batista
    5 out of 5 stars
    Simplesmente perfeita — virou meu café preferido todos os dias!
    Reviewed in Brazil on December 7, 2025
    Color: Stainless Steel
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    A Ninja Luxe Café Pro Series superou todas as minhas expectativas. A qualidade do espresso é incrível: extração consistente, sabor encorpado e uma crema que rivaliza com muitas cafeterias profissionais.

    O sistema Barista Assist facilita muito a vida, ajustando a moagem automaticamente e ajudando a encontrar o ponto ideal para cada grão. A máquina é rápida, intuitiva e muito estável — cada bebida sai igual à anterior, o que mostra o cuidado no design e na tecnologia.

    A steam wand é potente e produz uma microespuma cremosa, perfeita para cappuccinos e lattes. É exatamente o tipo de espuma que eu antes só conseguia em cafeterias especializadas.

    Outro ponto forte é a facilidade de manutenção. Os ciclos internos de limpeza são guiados, a interface explica tudo de forma clara e o processo é muito simples. Nunca tive problemas de entupimento ou variação de sabor.

    Além de tudo isso, o design é lindo, moderno e robusto. Dá aquela sensação de produto premium mesmo — parece peça de barista profissional dentro de casa.

    Depois que comprei, passei a preferir fazer meu café em casa ao invés de comprar fora. A Ninja realmente elevou meu padrão de café diário.

    Recomendo demais. Vale cada centavo!

About this Item

  • 4 MACHINES IN 1: Brew without limits with no guesswork espresso, well-balanced drip coffee, rapid cold brew, and an independent hot water system. 5 Espresso Styles — single, double shot or quad shot, ristretto & lungo. 3 Drip Coffee Styles—classic, rich or over ice, 2 Cold Brew styles — cold pressed espresso or cold brew coffee, and Independent Hot Water System – americanos, tea, and hot chocolate (drip coffee and cold brew available in 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 18 oz. sizes).
  • BARISTA ASSIST TECHNOLOGY: Unlock the ultimate guided experience with customized grind-size recommendations, weight-based dosing, and active brew adjustments for temperature & pressure for balanced flavor. Cafe-quality brews, no guesswork required.
  • INTEGRATED TAMPER: Tamp your grounds easily and mess free with the push of a lever, no overflowing grounds.
  • DUAL FROTH SYSTEM PRO: Unlock more froth options with the easy-to-clean, insulated steam wand and XL Milk Jug. Elevate your at-home coffee routine and create froth for two drinks with 5 preset froth functions including steamed milk, thin froth, thick froth, extra-thick froth, and cold foam.
  • GRIND SIZE RECOMMENDATIONS: Barista Assist Technology monitors each brew and adapts the grind size recommendation based on the previous brew to eliminate trial and error, or dial in based on your personal preferences. Note that you can prevent sour or bitter brews by following the recommended grind size.
  • INTEGRATED GRINDER AND WEIGHT-BASED DOSING: The conical burr grinder has 25 grind settings to deliver a fresh grind for versatile drink options. Built-in scale unlocks weight-based dosing tailored for your chosen drink. Other machines simply grind for a set amount of time, and you need to manually weigh your grounds.
  • HANDS-FREE FROTHING: Whether using dairy or plant-based milk, creating hot or cold microfoam, the Dual Froth System Pro combines steaming and whisking at the same time to effortlessly create perfectly textured microfoam, no skills required.
  • FLAVORFUL COLD-PRESSED DRINKS: Espresso brewed at lower temperature and pressure, at a slower pace to extract a more flavorful, smooth brew. Perfect for creating a crowd-pleasing espresso martini.
  • BUILT-IN STORAGE: Keep brew baskets, brush, and cleaning disc in the built-in storage compartment.
  • WHAT’S INCLUDED: Portafilter, XL Milk Jug, Single Basket, Double Basket, Luxe Basket, Cleaning Brush, Cleaning Disc, Descaling Powder, Cleaning tablets, Hard Water Testing Kit, Instructions & Inspiration Guide.

Product Description

The ultimate guided experience that makes espresso uncomplicated. The Ninja Luxe™ Café Pro Series is an intelligent espresso & coffee system with unmatched 4-in-1 versatility (no guesswork espresso machine, well balanced drip coffee maker, rapid cold brew creator and independent hot water system), that helps you elevate your coffee routine and create café-quality drinks at home. Create perfect pucks at the pull of a lever with the integrated tamper. Barista Assist Technology™ guides you to the perfect cup from grind size recommendations to automated brew adjustments, while the Dual Froth System Pro effortlessly creates perfectly textured microfoam hands-free. Easy-to-clean, insulated steam wand and XL Milk Jug elevate your at-home coffee routine, and create froth for two drinks with 5 preset froth functions including steamed milk, thin froth, thick froth, extra-thick froth, and cold foam.
